scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Baristha Bunakar and Karigara Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident/domicile of Odisha

Name must appear in the latest survey list of weavers, ancillary workers or artisans, unless the applicant is a National, Stale, Kalakruti, Tantakruti awardee or holds a Design/Merit certificate in the Handloom/Handicraft sector
Only one member per family can receive assistance
Government employees, income‑tax payers, retired government employees of the Union or any State Government are not eligible
Applicants receiving similar benefits under any other state or central government scheme (e.g., Madhubabu Pension Yojana, Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana) are ineligible
Anyone convicted of any criminal offence is ineligible
Beneficiaries cannot apply again after enrollment
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 per month for eligible weavers, ancillary workers and handicraft artisans (40‑79 years for females, 50‑79 years for males) and ₹2,500 per month for those aged 80 years or more.
documents_required: Income Certificate issued by the concerned Tahasildar/Additional Tahasildar or other competent revenue authority
